registration.title: Register as a Purohit / Brahmin
registration.description: Tell us about your practice, experience and service areas. Our team will contact you after reviewing your application.
registration.privacyNote: Your application is private. We never ask for your full Aadhaar number or bank details here.
registration.draftNotice: Your progress is saved only on this device. Avoid shared devices when entering personal information.

sections.identityTitle: Let us know who you are
sections.identityDescription: Use details through which our verification team can reach you.
sections.locationDescription: Keep this broad for now. You can update service areas during verification.
sections.practiceDescription: Share the background that helps us understand your practice.
sections.trustDescription: A reference is helpful but not required for this registration.
sections.consentDescription: Please review these permissions before sending your application.

fields.aadhaarAvailable: Is Aadhaar available for later verification?
fields.aadhaarHelp: Optional. Enter only the last four digits—never the full Aadhaar number.
fields.serviceAreas: Areas where you can provide services
fields.serviceAreasHelp: List cities, districts or nearby areas, separated by commas.
fields.affiliation: Temple, matha, peetha or institution affiliation
fields.backgroundHelp: Briefly share how you learned, your qualifications and the work you currently do.
fields.referencePermission: Share a reference only when you have their permission.
fields.discoverySource: How did you hear about BrahminBooking?
fields.truthConsent: I confirm that the information in this application is true to the best of my knowledge.
fields.contactConsent: I permit BrahminBooking to contact me and any reference I have provided for verification.
fields.privacyConsent: I agree to the privacy notice and understand that my information will be used for onboarding and verification.
fields.publicProfilePermission: After approval, BrahminBooking may prepare and publish my public profile. I can withdraw this permission later.

success.title: Thank you for registering.

privacy.title: How we use registration information
privacy.intro: BrahminBooking collects registration information to evaluate and onboard Purohits, Brahmins, temples and coordinators. Applications are not public.
privacy.collectBody: We collect the identity, contact, location, tradition, experience, services, optional reference and consent information entered in the form. We may collect optional Aadhaar availability and the last four digits only. We do not collect the full Aadhaar number, bank details or payment details in this form.
privacy.useBody: We use the information for contact, manual verification, reference checks when supplied, application review, fraud prevention and—only with separate permission—future public-profile preparation.
privacy.accessBody: Access is limited to authorized verification staff and service providers needed to operate Supabase. To correct or delete an application or withdraw public-profile permission, reply to the verification team's message or use the coordinator channel through which you were referred. Retention periods will be finalized before the external pilot.
